description: Defines classes and structures for Open Content Decryption Module (OpenCDM) management, including OpenCDMSystem, OpenCDMAccessor, and OpenCDMSession, with methods for session creation, key management, secure stop handling, and decryption operations.

classes.name: OpenCDMSystem
classes.description: Represents an OpenCDM system with key system and metadata.

classes.name: OpenCDMAccessor
classes.description: Provides access to OpenCDM sessions and capabilities, manages connection to remote OCDM implementation.

classes.name: OpenCDMSession
classes.description: Manages a single media decryption session, handles key status, decryption, and session lifecycle.

methods.name: CreateSession
methods.description: Creates a new OpenCDM session with specified parameters.

methods.name: GetDrmSystemTime
methods.description: Retrieves the DRM system time for a given key system.

methods.name: SetServerCertificate
methods.description: Sets the server certificate for a key system.

methods.name: Metadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a key system.

methods.name: Metricdata
methods.description: Retrieves metric data for a key system.

methods.name: BufferId
methods.description: Returns the buffer ID associated with the session.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Returns the key status for a given key ID.

methods.name: HasKeyId
methods.description: Checks if a key ID exists in the session.

methods.name: ResetOutputProtection
methods.description: Resets output protection on the session.

methods.name: SetParameter
methods.description: Sets a parameter on the session.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the session with license data.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption of encrypted data within the session.
